EAU paper details — arXiv:2610.16523, authors, benchmarks, and results — EAU paper details — arXiv:2610.16523, authors, benchmarks, and results # EAU arXiv:2610.16523 EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents is a meta-agent framework for user-centric agents. It adapts a hybrid user simulator, environment feedback, reward design, and RL configuration within and across runs. Evaluation covers UserGym, ColBench, and τ²-bench with Qwen3-4B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. ## A six-author collaboration. Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — Independent Researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Amii. ## Benchmarks and results. On Qwen3-4B, EAU reports 0.623 on UserGym, 0.600 ColBench task success, and 0.627 overall. The ColBench task-success result is a 36.7% relative gain over InfoPO under the paper’s protocol.
